senses.gloss: chain, rope or wreath (v. P. Sm. I, 532 בלורא = h. מעשה מקשה, a. בלוריא vincula jugi).—Pl. בְּלוּרִיּוֹת.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28:7">Gen. R. s. 28</cite>; Yalk. Zeph. 566 <he>ב׳ של זהב</he> (Gen. R. l. c. some ed. <cite ref="B00841"><he>בְּלֵרִיּוֹת</he></cite>) thick gold chains (as translation of <cite ref="J00749"><he>יתר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Job 22:20">Job XXII, 20</cite>).

senses.gloss: plait or locks, esp. the long hair worn by the Roman and Greek youths of the upper classes and offered to the gods on arriving at puberty (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. κόμη).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:3">Ab. Zar. I, 3</cite> <he>יום תגלחת זקנו ובלוריתוֹ</he> the day of shaving his (the gentile’s) beard and cutting his locks (v. Maim. a. l.). Ib. 29ᵃ.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:1">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:1">VII</cite>), 1.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:18">Deut. R. s. 2</cite> <he>העושה ב׳ וכ׳</he> he who grows a wig does so for none but an idolatrous purpose.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23:2">Lev. R. s. 23</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 82a:12">Snh. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>תפשה בבלוריתָהּ</he> he seized her by her plait.
